en: Kaede, what's wrong?

Tsu-Tsumugi couldn't have disguised
herself...

You understand, since you saw 
the cospox, right?
Cosplay is love.

You breathe life into characters. 
It's almost like you're summoning them...

From fiction into the real world...
Like an oracle channeling the gods.

That's why I can cosplay various characters 
from across the wide world of fiction...

But it's impossible to cosplay as someone 
who exists in the real world.

Because that's not cosplay, it's just 
impersonating someone.
I-I really didn't need that long explanation.
Huh? This chime...!

It's time, you bastards! Time for the
long-awaited class trial!

No, it's not! We're just announcing that the
photos are ready! Don't interrupt meeee!
Anyway, I'll be waiting at the warehouse.
...Huh?

Hey... Does my face look weird to you?
Has my face...always looked this weird?
So long! Bear-well!

Did you hear that, Shuichi?
The pictures have finally been developed!
Let's go! Come on, get a move on!
Ah! Wait, Kaede!

<CLT=cltMIND>I ran as fast as I could to the school
warehouse.

<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't stay put, knowing that the
truth was so close at hand.

You're going to ask Tsumugi about
what we talked about, right?

What's wrong? Did you find something 
outside?
Yeah, kinda...
Hmph, well that's a good thing, right?

I just want to make sure of something...
What were you doing when the body was found?

Oh, an alibi? Took you long enough
to ask me for mine.

Unfortunately, I don't have one.
I was just in my dorm room alone.

<CLT=cltMIND>That backs up what Keebo said...
But if you think about it...

<CLT=cltMIND>Since he said something that he knows will
make him suspicious...maybe I can trust him?

Unfortunately, I don't have an alibi.
I was just in my dorm room alone.

It just occurred to me... I never provided
you with my alibi.

During the body discovery announcement,
I was in the dining hall.
Kiyo, Tsumugi, and Miu were there as well.

Kiyo was dining, while Miu was tinkering with
some piece of machinery.

In retrospect...Miu was most likely working
on that drone of hers.
That corroborates what Kiyo was saying.

Kirumi and the others' alibis seem to check
out. Now...I just need to confirm Tsumugi's.
Umm...

Hey, Tsumugi...
I need to ask you something...
Ummmm...

She looks like she's busy thinking about
something, she won't talk to me...
Okay, but that's no excuse to give up.

<CLT=cltMIND>I grabbed the hem of Tsumugi's skirt,
and began to lift it slowly...

I'm gonna lift your skirt, Tsumugi.
You okay with that?
Wait! Kaede!

You better talk, or I'm gonna lift your skirt
for Shuichi to see.

And then I'm gonna tie your skirt around your
head so everyone can see your panties.
I understand. I just need to talk, right?
Oh, took you long enough.

Well, I can't let Shuichi's innocent eyes
get dirty...
Ah! No! They won't get dirty!
Are you saying you've seen dirtier, Shuichi?
What did you want to talk about?

I'm just gonna cut to the chase—since you're
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

That means you could disguise yourself
as anyone—even one of us, right?

Oh, so that's what you think of me. Well, 
since we're in this situation, I'll be clear...

I only cosplay fictional characters. I don't
cosplay real people...or rather, I can't.

You can't? Isn't it easy to just wear someone
else's clothes as a disguise and—
Cosplay isn't a disguise!
Ah! S-Sorry!

Well...you'll probably have a hard time 
believing me if I just say it, so I'll show you.
Show me...how?
Come on, Kaede.
Ah, wait!
Huh? Don't rush me!

I'm almost done sketchin' the floor plan!
Till then, just shut the hell up, Kaediot!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder if she'll finish the
sketches on time...
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to confirm Tsumugi's alibi...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
